operator_visible_outcome: Attempt evidence sources and tests are split by cohesive persistence ownership without changing retained bytes or state transitions

inputs.validation: Bounded tracked attempt-evidence source, test, record and state-transition inventories

outputs.validation: Deterministic attempt-evidence split acceptance or rejection with a bounded diagnostic

canonical_state: The attempt-evidence declaration, test, build-tag and record inventories are preserved across the split
Construction, record model, staging, publication, recovery and terminal lifecycle are owned by store.go, record.go, stage.go, publish.go, recover.go and terminal.go
Record shape, evidence binding and closed state transitions are owned by record_validation.go, observation_validation.go and transition.go
Reservation, ownership marker and rooted lock validation are owned by lock.go, ownership.go and lock_root.go
Windows atomic publication, ACL validation and interrupted-record repair are owned by publish_windows.go, acl_windows.go and repair_windows.go
Linux AMD64 no-replace publication, ext4 or XFS validation, ownership, locking and interrupted-record repair are owned by the linux_amd64 platform files
Tests are redistributed only by the behaviour and fault boundary named in the maintained plan
derived_state: Focused persistence, corruption, interruption, contention and independent Assurance verdicts

success_semantics: Accepted means the exact declared source split preserves symbols, tests, record bytes, atomicity, locks, corruption refusal, interruption recovery and state transitions
refusal_semantics: An old mixed-responsibility file, missing destination, undeclared sibling, changed inventory, duplicate implementation, wrapper or persistence regression returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release source and formats may be replaced directly; no old reader, writer, migration, wrapper, forwarding file or duplicate implementation is retained
falsifiers: A declaration, test, build constraint or retained record byte changes during the split
An old mixed-responsibility file remains or a destination file is missing
An undeclared sibling source or test file appears in the attempt package
A wrapper, duplicate validator, migration path or order dependency is introduced
Atomicity, locks, corruption refusal, interruption recovery, state transitions or unsupported-platform refusal change

production_controls.owner: source-policy attempt split inventory and declaration fixtures
source-policy split inventory and focused record and transition fixtures
attempt package persistence, contention, corruption and crash-point tests

assurance_controls.owner: independent attempt split inventory and declaration comparison
independent persistence, fault and retained-evidence inspection

residual_limitations: This structural split does not establish new persistence or operation behaviour
Native Windows and Linux AMD64 persistence remain separately governed and qualified
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change record bytes, atomicity, durability, locks, corruption handling, interruption recovery, state transitions or platform refusal
Create an interface, wrapper, registry, option or duplicate implementation
Retain an old reader, writer, migration, mixed-responsibility file or forwarding compatibility path
Change admission, transformation, protocol, supervision, worker or operation behaviour
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes the split inventory
